description: This file implements the EstablishingController for managing the establishment state of CustomResourceDefinitions (CRDs) in Kubernetes, including queue management, synchronization, and condition updates.

classes.name: EstablishingController
classes.description: Controller for managing the establishment process of CRDs, including queue processing and condition updates.

methods.name: NewEstablishingController
methods.description: Creates a new instance of EstablishingController with provided CRD informer and client.

methods.name: QueueCRD
methods.description: Adds a CRD key to the queue with a specified delay.

methods.name: RunWithContext
methods.description: Starts the controller with a context, managing lifecycle and worker routines.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the controller with a stop channel, using context for logging.

methods.name: runWorker
methods.description: Processes items from the queue in a loop.

methods.name: processNextWorkItem
methods.description: Handles one queue item, calling sync and managing retries.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Synchronizes CRD state, setting conditions based on validation and current status.
